newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Dealers brace for cold.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Dealers brace for cold.

text.p: U.S. grain dealers in the northern Plains said Tuesday they were bracing for a fresh blast of bitter cold temperatures, which could cause further logistical problems in shipping grain.

"By Thursday, we're supposed to get highs of 10 to 15 (degrees Fahrenheit) below zero," a dealer in central Montana said. "The big concern is whether we'll get any snow cover to help (insulate) the winter wheat out here."
Movement of wheat through the Dakotas and Minnesota has been slowed in recent days as blizzards and snowdrifts shut down efforts to load grain cars.

Meanwhile, the rise in spring wheat futures prices at the Minneapolis Grain Exchange Tuesday triggered some farmer and elevator sales, and at least one Montana grain buyer lowered basis levels to discourage more selling.
